assignments.node_id: אם האדם מבטל עצמו, ואינו כלל מזה העולם
assignments.reason: This node describes the act of self-nullification — being utterly nothing from this world. Package 2 already contains 'ביטול עצמו / אינו כלל מזה העולם' which is the same concept expressed in the same words. The essential nature of this node is the ayin/bitul state, which is the core domain of Package 2 (Wisdom and Nothingness).

assignments.node_id: אינו עושה צל, ומקבל אור השם יתברך
assignments.reason: This compound node describes two linked results: not casting a shadow and receiving God's light. Its essential nature is the reception of divine light (אור השם יתברך), which is the defining concept of Package 1 (Divine Light and Honor). The 'not making shadow' component is the removal of the obstacle, but the positive reality being described — what the person now receives — is the divine light/kavod that defines Package 1. The node's telos and essential content is the influx of divine light, not the shadow-domain.
